item.title: The Feast of the Transfiguration
item.description: My parish sponsored a quiet evening tonight ( to my Godly Play class this year. I actually chose to write out the text of the transfiguration. The room was pretty quiet, we knew the other participants were elsewhere around the church and grounds in prayer, and writing out the central text felt like a meditation itself for me. Pretty cool.
